title: SmartGadget
tagline: A wholesale gadget shop with an open admin dashboard
description: A complete wholesale electronics storefront for the Bangladeshi market — catalogue, tiered wholesale pricing, product pages, cart, checkout and order tracking — plus the admin dashboard the owner runs it from: products, stock, orders, customers, reviews, content and analytics. The dashboard opens with no sign-in so a prospect can look straight through it, and every product, order, customer and figure in it is generated rather than real.
highlights: Volume pricing that steps down as quantity rises, shown per product
Admin dashboard with no password — nothing sits behind it to protect
Every number agrees: the dashboard totals are summed from the same orders the order list shows
Edits stick while you browse — change a price and the revenue and margin move with it
Mobile-first — built for phones before desktop

admin.label: Admin dashboard
admin.note: No sign-in. 14 screens — products, orders, stock, customers, analytics.
